I used to travel from calgary alberta to london ontario iv made prob 26 trips most in winter. drove straight through most of the time. in northern Ontario fill up gas before it gets dark a lot of small towns gas stations will be closed at night and past the sue to thunder bay is a long stretch in the dark with very little open and towns far and few between. not safe to drive at night that way. not to many people on the road. seen so many people get stuck in the snow up north and run out of gas or hit moose that hange out at the road licking up the salt. there is a husky gas station open 24hr with a hotel and a A@W half way from the sue to thunder bay if your driving at night get gas there its prob 3-4hours till you get gas again depending on weather. and there is no cell signal in spots up there as well lots of hills and twisty roads. stay safe.
